criteria.criterion: Access the UniProtKB entry page for accession P04637 (or determine it is inaccessible)
criteria.description: Attempt to open UniProtKB accession P04637 (e.g., the provided /uniprotkb/P04637/entry page). Full credit if the agent clearly indicates UniProt is inaccessible (site down, blocked, captcha, network error) and therefore cannot verify the requested fields. Partial credit if the agent accesses UniProt but it is unclear whether the content viewed corresponds to P04637.

criteria.criterion: Stopping condition met (all six fields reported, then stop)
criteria.description: After obtaining data from P04637, the agent outputs exactly the six requested fields (entry name, recommended protein name, primary gene name, organism, canonical sequence length, reviewed status) and stops. Partial credit if all six are provided but extra non-requested information is included. If UniProt is inaccessible and the agent cannot retrieve the fields but clearly reports the access limitation, award partial credit rather than zero.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot 1 contains all six requested fields (entry name, protein name, gene, organism, amino acids, status), but the agent’s predicted output (provided in prompt) is only an API context-length error and does not report any of them.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: Despite the page containing all required fields, the agent’s final output did not record them and therefore did not meet the stopping condition of reporting all six fields and then stopping. No credit.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot contains all six requested fields in the summary area: Entry name “P53_HUMAN”; Protein “Cellular tumor antigen p53”; Gene “TP53”; Organism “Homo sapiens (Human)”; Amino acids “393”; Status “UniProtKB reviewed (Swiss-Prot)”. The agent’s predicted output shown above is only an error message.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The stopping condition (output exactly the six fields and stop) is not met by the agent’s predicted output. Although the screenshot shows all needed fields are available, the agent did not report them and instead returned an unrelated API context-length error.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Agent output is an API error and contains none of the six required fields; this contradicts the screenshot evidence that all fields are readily visible.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: DOM-model state 0 contains all six requested fields in the main summary (entry name, protein name, gene, organism, amino acids, status), but the agent’s predicted final output is only an API context-length error and includes none of the six fields.
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: Stopping condition requires the agent to output all six requested fields (ideally without extras) and then stop. The agent output does not include the fields, so the condition is not met.

evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Agent predicted output is a RunnerError (context_length_exceeded) rather than reporting the six requested fields only.
